tasks.label: 🎯 Build Current File (Direct)
args: mkdir -p ${fileDirname}/build && MODULE_FLAGS="-fmodule-file=std=${workspaceFolder}/build/modules/std.pcm"; MODULE_OBJS="${workspaceFolder}/build/modules/std.o"; for pcm in ${workspaceFolder}/build/modules/*.pcm; do [ "$pcm" != "${workspaceFolder}/build/modules/std.pcm" ] && [ -f "$pcm" ] && MODULE_NAME=$(basename "$pcm" .pcm) && OBJ_FILE="${workspaceFolder}/build/modules/$MODULE_NAME.o" && IMPL_OBJ_FILE="${workspaceFolder}/build/modules/${MODULE_NAME}_impl.o" && [ -f "$OBJ_FILE" ] && MODULE_FLAGS="$MODULE_FLAGS -fmodule-file=$MODULE_NAME=$pcm" && MODULE_OBJS="$MODULE_OBJS $OBJ_FILE" && [ -f "$IMPL_OBJ_FILE" ] && MODULE_OBJS="$MODULE_OBJS $IMPL_OBJ_FILE"; done; clang++-19 -std=c++23 -stdlib=libc++ $MODULE_FLAGS -fprebuilt-module-path=${workspaceFolder}/build/modules -g -O0 ${file} $MODULE_OBJS -o ${fileDirname}/build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}

tasks.label: 🎓 Build Current Module
args: if [[ "${file}" == *.cppm ]]; then echo "🏗️ Building module interface: ${fileBasenameNoExtension}"; mkdir -p "${workspaceFolder}/build/modules"; clang++-19 -std=c++23 -stdlib=libc++ -fmodule-file=std="${workspaceFolder}/build/modules/std.pcm" -fprebuilt-module-path="${workspaceFolder}/build/modules" --precompile "${file}" -o "${workspaceFolder}/build/modules/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.pcm"; clang++-19 -std=c++23 -stdlib=libc++ -fmodule-file=std="${workspaceFolder}/build/modules/std.pcm" -fprebuilt-module-path="${workspaceFolder}/build/modules" -c "${workspaceFolder}/build/modules/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.pcm" -o "${workspaceFolder}/build/modules/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.o"; IMPL_FILE="${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.cpp"; if [ -f "$IMPL_FILE" ]; then echo "🔧 Found implementation file, compiling together..."; clang++-19 -std=c++23 -stdlib=libc++ -fmodule-file=std="${workspaceFolder}/build/modules/std.pcm" -fmodule-file=${fileBasenameNoExtension}="${workspaceFolder}/build/modules/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.pcm" -fprebuilt-module-path="${workspaceFolder}/build/modules" -c "$IMPL_FILE" -o "${workspaceFolder}/build/modules/${fileBasenameNoExtension}_impl.o"; else echo "🔧 No implementation file found, compiling interface only..."; clang++-19 -std=c++23 -stdlib=libc++ -fmodule-file=std="${workspaceFolder}/build/modules/std.pcm" -fprebuilt-module-path="${workspaceFolder}/build/modules" -c "${workspaceFolder}/build/modules/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.pcm" -o "${workspaceFolder}/build/modules/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.o"; fi; echo "✅ Module ${fileBasenameNoExtension} built successfully!"; echo "🔧 Auto-updating .clangd config..."; bash "${workspaceFolder}/scripts/update-clangd-modules.sh" "${fileBasenameNoExtension}"; else echo "❌ This task is only for .cppm files"; fi
tasks.detail: 📚 Build current .cppm file (single-file or two-file modules)
